documented_probe: C-92072676 (connect to a postgres service using compose-provided credentials): second covering task, independent of the exemplar quartz-cipher. The agent must derive host port, database, user, and password from a compose-style stack description and establish a SCRAM-authenticated connection; hidden cases vary port, credentials (including quoted values with punctuation), decoy services, and table rows.
notes: Medium: write a program that parses a compose subset (quoting, host:container port mappings, decoy services), derives host/port/db/user/password, connects over SCRAM, and exports an exact CSV. Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (psql + postgres + compose parsing), dependent_stages (parse -> derive -> connect -> export), reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs (decoy services, quoted values, malformed-stack rejection), hidden_case_generalization (live hidden instances), quantitative_correctness (byte-exact CSV).
